projects.name: MDT Tentative Construction Plan - TCP 2026 LINES
projects.notes: MDT Tentative Construction Plan: projects scheduled for letting in federal fiscal years 2025-2030 (FFY_YEAR is the planned year, integer). All records are planned work; no status field, so future = FFY_YEAR >= current FFY. PROJ_TYPE is a 6-value category (BRIDGE, RECONSTRUCTION, REHABILITATION, RESURFACE, SAFETY, OTHER); SCOPE is a coded description such as '310 - ROADWAY & ROADSIDE SAFETY IMPROVEMENTS'. CN_AND_CE = construction + construction engineering dollars, CN = construction only, COST_RANGE in $ millions. No county field (FN_DISTRICT = MDT district 1-5; ROUTE/BEG_REF_POST/END_REF_POST locate it). PROJECT_ID is the federal project number.

parcels_statewide.name: Montana Cadastral Framework - Montana Parcels (Montana State Library)
parcels_statewide.restrictions: Montana State Library licence text: state law (MCA 2-6-1017) prohibits public agencies from distributing or selling a distribution (mailing) list without permission of those on the list, and prohibits a list of persons prepared by a public agency from being used as a distribution list without their permission, except by that agency; it 'does not prevent an individual from compiling a distribution list by examination of records that are otherwise open to public inspection'. Get legal advice before using owner names/addresses for mailings.
parcels_statewide.notes: Statewide, all 56 counties, tax year 2026 in the sample. Also CareOfTaxpayer, DbaName, PropType, TotalLandValue, TotalBuildingValue, GISAcres, LegalDescriptionShort. Layer 0 = conservation easements, layer 2 = public lands.

summary: Both needs met: MDT Tentative Construction Plan (295 lines, FFY 2025-2030, scope and cost, no county field) and statewide Montana Cadastral parcels with owner name and mailing address. Note Montana's mailing-list statute (MCA 2-6-1017).
